How does the day change in peak
Besides the owner, who else works the counter
Three counter clerks and a counter lead, Marcus. Clerks take orders and look up stock. Only Marcus and I can change a price, approve credit, or release an order for an account that is past due.
Mostly phone calls and texts to the counter cell phone. A few of the big marinas email a list on Monday mornings. No website ordering at all.
Roughly what share of your orders are urgent
In season about 60 percent are same-day, a boat is on the lift and the mechanic is waiting. Off season it flips, mostly planned restocking.
When a marina chooses you over another
Speed and knowing their boats. We get the part to the slip the same day and we know what their service manager usually needs. We are not the cheapest.
